rows.grounds: compound denoting an alternative option; nominative singular neuter in apposition
demonstrative pronoun referring to the previously stated alternative
adjective qualifying the stated option as subordinate
noun restating the alternative as a ritual option

items.question: What doctrinal status is assigned to this alternative ritual option?
premises: An alternative option is being identified.
This identified option is characterized as secondary.
The characterization applies to the previously mentioned ritual alternative.
items.inference: The previously mentioned alternative is a secondary option rather than a primary one.
uncertainties: The exact scope of what counts as primary in contrast to this secondary option is not specified within this verse alone.
items.plain_english: This other option is a secondary alternative.
